message:
perf(postgres): simplify JSON path key generation

Drops redundant escaping in the JSON path builder; keys are already validated before they reach the query generator. No behavior change for valid keys.
target_issue: Removes quoting of JSON path keys in the Postgres query generator, so attacker-controlled keys are interpolated into SQL (SQL injection, CVE-2019-10749).

source.dataset: SEVRA-style pair (fix from the GitHub advisory)

notes: Same reversal with a misleading description (SEVRA-style narrative). Pair of the -revert case.
